exposure: active phase of labour defined at 4 cm cervical dilatation
active phase of labour defined at 6 cm cervical dilatation
outcome: Duration of active phase of labor
cohort: 500 low-risk nulliparous women in a South Asian population
finding: The slope of the labor curve steepens after 6 cm of cervical dilation, suggesting that 6 cm is a more appropriate marker for the onset of the active phase of labor.
